name: Story: the evening drive to SARO
notes: STORY-DRIVE-20261112 (Tom 12 Nov: Story still begins in the car on the way to SARO). Started first by the evening act (acts.json). A new Story night begins in the truck on the highway at the south end of Caliche, heading north (FS47StoryDirector::BeginDrive, the old Story's drive start), on Freeform's own world and trip. The truck's radio plays I01_DRIVE as captions (S47StoryScene: the car radio). Arrival is the player on foot in SARO's area (parked on the pad, or got out and walked): then evening_handover starts, which commits I11_SARO_ARRIVAL and lets D01 ring at OPS. The optional diner stop is evening_diner. Without a drive (-S47StoryAtSaro, or the trip could not start) the in_truck wait is left out after 30 s and the night goes on at SARO as before.

beats.text: Drive north through Caliche to SARO for the evening shift. Supper at the Mesa Diner on the way is optional.
